Manual QA Checklist
Branch under test: fix/m1-1190/block-schedule-date-off-by-one
Tester role: coordinator

Scope Summary
- Block schedule was displaying dates one day earlier than entered.
- Change touches the schedule serializer and the schedule list template.

What to do first
- Log in as a curriculum coordinator on the deploy.

Numbered test steps
1. [P0] Navigate to Curriculum > Block Schedule for the Internal Medicine program.
   Expected: The Block Schedule page loads without errors.
2. [P0] Create a block starting 2026-05-12 and save it.
   Expected: The saved block shows the date 2026-05-12, not 2026-05-11.
3. [P1] Open the block schedule list view.
   Expected: Displays "Internal Medicine" and shows no console error.
4. Re-open the saved block in edit mode.
   Expected: Field "start_date" equals "2026-05-12".
5. [P2] Hover the info tooltip on the date column.
   Expected: Looks correct.
